coverage.scopeWarning: This covers only the cards we track. Never phrase a count as 'ever' from this data.

scopingRule: Coverage is PARTIAL. Every count is phrased 'in the sets we track'. An 'only N ever' claim is forbidden from this data.

angles.post:
Umbreon VMAX from Evolving Skies sits at $2,244 ungraded.

It was illustrated by KEIICHIRO ITO.

Everyone can tell you what this card costs. Fewer can tell you who drew it.
angles.why: Art accounts have the taste and none of the data. Price accounts have the data and never look at who drew it. This is the only lane that holds both.

angles.post:
aky CG Works's work spans 6 years of Pokémon cards in the sets we track — Sword & Shield in 2020 through Ascended Heroes in 2026.

Sets rotate, prices move, and somebody has quietly been drawing this whole time.
angles.why: Longevity is a story the market never tells, because the market only looks at what changed today.
sources: pokemontcg.io artist credits and set release dates
